projects.name: Federated Lasso Regression
projects.description: Three simulated data nodes train one shared sparse model without ever sharing raw data, compared against a centralized baseline.

projects.name: Image Segmentation from Scratch
projects.description: Felzenszwalb segmentation, SLIC superpixels and blob detection, written without a computer vision library and compared side by side on a photo.

upload.label: Use your own photo
upload.hint: JPG, PNG, BMP or WebP. It's converted to grayscale and shrunk to 300 px on its longest side.

projects.name: Word Recognition Memory Experiment
projects.description: A psychology experiment I designed and ran: do people remember words better when they fit the scene? Includes the analysis of the results.

projects.name: Bingo Card Generator
projects.description: Builds a random 5 × 5 bingo card from numbers or your own list of words and draws it as an image.

demo.runtime: a few seconds once Python has loaded

text.label: Your own words (optional)
text.placeholder: At least 25 words or short phrases, one per line or separated by commas
text.hint: Enter at least 25 different words or short phrases; if you give more, 25 are picked at random.
text.example: Someone says "synergy", Coffee spill, Laptop dies mid-demo, Dog barks on call, "Can you hear me now?", Wrong slide deck, Frozen video, Echo on the line, Background noise, "Let's take this offline", Late arrival, Mute button fail, Kid walks in, Internet drops, "You're on mute", Screen share fails, Calendar double-booked, Meeting runs over, Pet on keyboard, Doorbell rings, Forgot to unmute, Typing loudly, Bad lighting, Someone eating, Camera off all meeting, Awkward silence
